summary: Fix ProductSet subset/equality comparisons with FiniteSet by safely rewriting enumerable finite products to FiniteSet. Add regressions for the reported equality simplification and subset failure, incomplete/extended sets, symbolic coordinates, nested products, Range factors, and infinite or undecidable factors. Public tests: sympy/sets/tests/test_sets.py: 97 passed, 4 expected failures; full sympy/sets/tests plus sympy/core/tests/test_relational.py: 253 passed, 8 expected failures. Inspected complete diff.
